Commentary.Commentary: Right then! England, the way they started off in Rajkot were completely opposite after it. When a team loses a series 4-0, they need some real soul-searching. On the other hand, the No. 1 Test team has only got better with every passing game and today they showed that they are on top for some reason. The action isn't over yet. These teams will continue to battle in the New Year. We now have a 3-match ODI series followed with 3 T20Is starting from 15th January, 2017 at 1430 IST in Pune. Hope you have enjoyed our coverage and really hope to have you on board for future games. Until next time, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

The Test trophy is now handed to the proud Indian skipper, Virat Kohli. He gets another one under his belt and then his mates join in to pose for the photographs. The Chepauk crowd lauds them and they deserve every bit of it, don't they?

MAN OF THE SERIES AND VICTORIOUS INDIAN SKIPPER, VIRAT KOHLI on winning the match says that this match is an evidence of character to battle out for even the last match of the series after already winning the series 3-0. He also adds that he wanted the youngsters to step up as they have the talent and had got out cheaply till now. He also said that KL Rahul has had an excellent season with the bat in the domestic circuit but he was not able to convert it here and he nearly got the double ton. Lauds Jadeja as he did the job for them in both the innings with the ball. Admits his team had the caliber to push this English team on the back foot. Informs the atmosphere in the dressing room is very lively as every one helps each other as and when needed. Feels the thing to watch out for in this series was that they never thought that they were out of the game and always bounced back. Is really happy to accept the fact that his pacers were better than oppositions'. Ends by saying that he is really delighted to see every member in the team stepping up at some point or the other.

ENGLISH SKIPPER, ALASTAIR COOK doesn't want to give any excuse and starts by crediting the Indian team and accepts that they outclassed them. Adds they started off well but after lunch they gave it away and feels there were some roughs on the pitch due to which the odd ball spun. Further says the main reason they lost the series was because they kept dropping crucial chances and the home side punished them for the same. Continues by saying how important it is to take the those chances. Opines it isn't easy to play 5 Tests in 6 weeks and that it is also a tough place to come and win and ends up saying they weren't a good opposition.

MAN OF THE MATCH, KARUN NAIR says on his triple ton that he thinks it will take some time to sink in and he could not sleep last night as he had too many messages to reply to. Further says it was a very good feeling to win and to contribute to a winning cause and putting in the effort to win the series 4-0.  He also adds that it is a very beautiful place to be in the company of senior players.

Day 5, two sessions left and Ravindra Jadeja had other ideas. He literally wrecked havoc and outclassed his partner in crime - Ashwin.  He took 10 wickets in the match which also happens to be his best figures in Tests. The Indians have once again proved that it's not only difficult to beat them in their own den but it is next to impossible. Let's wait and see what the captains of both the teams have to say...

It was Moeen Ali for the visitors who scored 146 and that was outclassed by KL Rahul who missed out on a double ton by one run but in the end the limelight was stolen by the young man, Karun Nair who went onto score a triple century and helped his side post a mammoth total on the board. With the track not having any demons in it, one would have thought this match could very well head towards a draw and with how Cook and Jennings saw off the session this morning, not many would have thought what is stored next.

The English batsmen after putting up an impressive performance with the bat, succumbed to pressure and have themselves to blame to have not survived just two sessions on the final day. Cook will be really bewailed with this performance as they couldn't make the most of it after winning the all-important toss on day 1. They got runs on the board but as has been the case in the series, whatever England scored, India went past it almost every time they had a go with the willow.

The Indian team has done it, they have bowled out the deep English batting line-up and mind you, they went wicketless in the morning session. Ravindra Jadeja, the tormentor-in-chief came out all guns blazing after lunch and spun the web viciously to bundle out the visitors. He claimed a 7-fer on what was a flat deck, oh boy, this is something spectacular.

Outside off, turning in, Ali gets back and flicks it past short leg for a single.
Ali has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Around middle and off, defended down watchfully.
Loopy ball around off, Moeen pushes it towards the off side with soft hands.
Short and outside off, Root looks to ride the bounce but flat bats it towards cover-point.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Good length ball on off, Ali punched it towards covers.
Short of a length ball on middle, rising up a bit, Ali tries to sway away from it but the ball hurries onto him and he gets hit on the gloves as the ball dies down on the pitch.
Full and strays it down the leg side, at 146 kph, Ali looks to flick but misses. Patel collects it and they appeal for a catch which is turned down.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Ali ducks to evade it.
Flattish on middle, Root is happy to block it. Another successful over from Jaddu.
Loopy ball outside off, Ali prods forward to defend but gets an outside edge past first slip for a single.
MOEEN ALI comes into bat.

OUT! Caught and bowled! Jadeja has another as England lose both their openers. Jadeja bowls a loopy ball outside off, Jennings comes down the track to play at it but the ball hits the boots and rises to hit him on the bat as he went too hard at it. Chips it back to Jadeja who grabs a dolly gleefully. That's a tame dismissal and Keaton Jennings walks back but not before playing a fighting innings. India sensing something?
FOUR! Good use of the feet there! Tossed up delivery around middle, Jennings comes down the track and whips it with the spin through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Loopy ball around middle and off, Jennings looks to drive it but gets an inside edge on the pads and then it lobs towards short leg where it falls short of Pujara.
Root stays behind the line and offers a straight bat defense.
Maiden Test fifty for KEATON JENNINGS!

Good length ball on the pads, clipped towards mid-wicket for a single. It brings up his fifty as well. He converted one into a ton in Mumbai, is another one on cards? But for now, he wants to enjoy this for a while. The job is not done yet and he very well knows it.
Once again it's hurled fuller outside off, the reply is same. It's driven once again towards the cover fielder.
Fuller in length and served outside off, once again it's driven towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller and angling in, driven towards short extra cover.
Short of a length ball outside off, Jennings taps it straight to the man at gully who collects it on the bounce.
JR has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy ball around middle, Joe comes forward to flick but closes the face of the bat a bit early and gets a leading edge towards silly point.
On middle and leg, Root gets across and defends it down.
Outside off, Jennings gets down and reverse sweeps it through backward point for a single.
Loopy ball around off, it's bunted back to the bowler.
Full on middle and leg, worked towards the on side for a single.
Comes from around the wicket and angles a full ball on off, KJ comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Very full outside off, driven towards mid off for nothing.
Beaten! Yadav hurls a full length delivery, at 147 kph, in the channel outside off, asking Jennings to go after it. He obliges and is lucky not to nick that one.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On a length and outside off, Keaton leaves it alone.
On a length and around middle, defended with a straight bat.
UMESH YADAV comes in for a bowl.
Fuller in length and outside off, pushed towards covers.
Outside leg, Root pads it away.
JOE ROOT, the English run-machine comes out to bat, replacing Cook.

OUT! Jadeja strikes and for the umpteenth number of times he removes Cook! A bunny in every sense you can say. But credit to KL Rahul for taking a superb catch as well. This was down the leg side, at 94 kph, Cook could have left it alone but instead feels for it. He flicks and it goes towards the Indian opener at leg gully who takes a sharp catch instinctively. He is up and running and Jadeja has his arms aloft. Captain Cook walks back missing out on a fifty by a mere one run. First success today for the home side, can they build the pressure now?
Outside off, Cook shoulders his arms to that one.
Flatter one around off, the batsman shows a straight bat.
Drags it short on off, Jennings cuts it towards third man for a single.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Flighted ball around middle and off, once again Cook offers a solid front foot defense.
Prods forward and keeps it out with a straight bat.
Floated around off, defended into the ground.

A shout for lbw, turned down! Ash tosses it up around middle, Jennings gets down to sweep but it goes off something towards fine leg. They appeal but the umpire says not out. Replays show it went off the gloves. A single taken.
Loopy ball around off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
RAVI ASHWIN to bowl from the other end!
The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
Flat and short outside off, punched square off the wicket on the off side for a couple.
Full and down the leg side, Cook looks to flick but misses.

NOT OUT! The decision stays as it is! Jadeja bowls a loopy ball outside off, gets it to turn in sharply. Cook gets across to flick but misses as the ball goes off the pads towards fine leg. The English batsmen are busy running and Jadeja keeps on appealing. The umpire turns it down. Kohli takes the review and replays show it was in line and would have gone on to miss the stumps. Two leg byes taken and India lose the review as well.
India have taken a review against Cook for an LBW. Is it spinning too much?
Tossed up around off, Cook gets forward and defends it off the front foot.
Full and around middle, nudged towards short mid-wicket.

Welcome back for the second session. Can England continue the good work? Or will Ashwin and co. come out all guns blazing? Remains to be seen. COOK and JENNINGS are out to bat again. India will begin with RAVINDRA JADEJA! Here we go...
...DAY 5, SESSION 2...

India will have to come back in a short while and try to get some quick wickets so that they can put the visitors on back foot. Currently a draw seems imminent if not we will need to get a dramatic lapse from the Englishmen to get a result against them. It will be exciting to see how the second session paves out. Join us in a while for the post-lunch session at 1210 IST.

The session which England needed to go in their favour and the captain has lead it with example here. Cook and Jennings have played out the whole session and have managed to get some runs on the board as well. They will be really happy as they head back to the dressing room for some quick bites. The Indian bowlers started off really well creating pressure with the ball but they were unable to get a breakthrough. A couple of drop catches and that saw the pressure dropping . It seemed for a while that the hosts are just trying to keep the overs going.
Flighted ball around off, Jennings drives it towards covers where Jadeja dives to his right to stop that one. LUNCH ON DAY 5!
Flatter one around middle, Jennings punches it off the back foot towards point.
Flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

In the air... safe again! It came a lot quicker than what Pujara expected! Flighted full ball around middle, Cook looks to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge just past Pujara at silly point. Ooohhhss and Aaahssss on the field now.
Quicker through the air around middle, Cook lunges forward in defense.
On middle and leg, Keaton sweeps it firmly through backward square leg for a single.

A shout for a catch or LBW not sure! Outside off, turning in sharply from over the wicket. Cook gets back to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. It then goes towards leg gully where the fielder takes it with a dive to his right. An appeal is made but it seemed to be going down leg and for the catch, it was off the pads.
Goes over the wicket again and serves it full around off, Cook makes a good stride forward and defends.
Lunges forward and buries it into the ground.
Comes from around the wicket and bowls a loopy delivery on middle, Cook defends it down watchfully.
Full around middle, flicked on a bounce to short leg.
Full outside off, skidding in, Cook stays back in defense.
FOUR! Off the meat of the bat! Loopy ball around middle and leg, Jennings gets down and brings out the reverse sweep. Makes a good connection and sends it through point for a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter one around middle, Cook gets back and tucks it towards mid-wicket. Mishra gives it a chase but still they take three.
Loopy ball around off, Alastair presses forward and pushes it towards covers.
Prods forward and keeps it out with a straight blade.
Floats it up around middle and off, Cook presses forward and pushes it with soft hands back to the bowler.
RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN replaces RAVINDRA JADEJA.
Pushed quicker through the air around middle, Jennings looks to flick but gets hit on the pads.
Keaton gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Comes down the track and works it towards Jadeja at short mid-wicket.
Misfield! Flatter one around middle, Cook comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler who fails to stop that one. A single taken and Kohli isn't happy at all.
A shout for a catch, turned down! Outside off, turning in sharply, Cook gets back to flick but it goes off the pads and Patel moves to his left to collect. They appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Bowls a loopy leg break around off, turning in sharply, Cook gets back and then lets it hit his thigh pad.
A bit short, Jennings stays in his crease to defend it.
Jennings leans forward to defend it.

FIVE OVERTHROWS! Tossed up, Cook drives it towards mid on for a single and Amit Mishra is quick to gather it and throws it on the striker's end. An awkward bounce denies Parthiv to gather it and the ball runs away to the fence.
Tossed outside off, Jennings reverse sweeps it uppishly towards backward point for a single.
Floated on the stumps, Cook flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Bowled on the pads, Jennings tries to nudge it fine down the leg side but is unable to make contact and the ball goes fine hitting the pads. Leg bye is taken.
Once again this one comes in, Keaton gets back and punches it towards covers for a single.
Outside off, turning in sharply and going down leg. Jennings leaves it alone.

Lunges forward to a full ball and blocks.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shout for a catch! Flatter through the air around off, Cook presses forward to defend but gets beaten. Patel collects and they appeal for a catch. A shake of a head from umpire Erasmus.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
Falls short! Floats it up around middle and off, Cook comes forward to defend, it hits high on the bat and falls just short of the man at short leg.
Pushed quicker through the air around middle, Jennings turns it past leg slip towards fine leg for a single.
Quicker one around middle, Cook goes for a delicate glance but is lucky as the ball falls well short of the man at leg gully.

Loopy ball outside off, turning in, Cook looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.

FOUR! Shot that! Loopy ball outside off, Cook gets down and brings out the sweep in front of square for a boundary.
Drifting around middle, turning in as Cook looks to flick but it goes off the pads towards fine leg and they take two leg byes.

FOUR! Good shot! Ashwin bowls a low full toss outside off, Jennings goes down on one knee and reverse sweeps it through third man for a boundary.

A shout for a catch this time! Quicker through the air outside off, Jennings looks to defend it off the front foot but misses and Patel collects it. They start to appeal but the umpire isn't interested. Replays show that the sound was of bat hitting the ground.

A loud shout for LBW! Jadeja immediately making the impact. Loopy ball around off, turning in sharply as Cook looks to defend it off the front foot but misses as the ball raps in on the pads. Jadeja appeals for a leg before but it is turned down. Replays show it was in line but would have missed the stumps.
RAVINDRA JADEJA comes in for a bowl.

Flighted ball around middle and off, Jennings tries to defend it off the front foot but gets an inside edge on the pads and dies down before the man at short leg could react. Frustration continues for Ashwin.
Loopy ball outside off, driven towards the man at mid off.

Stays put in the crease and defends.
Strays it down the leg side, Alastair looks to flick but fails to get any bat on it. A good take by Parthiv behind the stumps.
On a length and outside off, Cook defends it with a straight bat.

Cook gets in line of the ball to flick it for a single through mid-wicket.

No run.
On the pads, Jennings flicks it on the on side for a single.
Floated up, Cook stays in his crease to defend it.
Cook gets in line of the ball to defend it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

LUCKY COUPLE! Tossed up outside off, Cook tries to defend it but he edges it towards second slip. The ball falls short of Vijay who dives forward but is unable to stop the ball and the ball tickles away for a couple.
Cook gets in line of the ball to defend it.
Tossed up on the stumps, again beaten by Ash. Cook leans into the delivery and tries to defend it but the ball spins away.
THAT'S REALLY NASTY! A fast short zipping delivery on the body, Jennings tries to defend it but is unable to make contact and the ball goes and hits his shoulder.
Length ball outside off, Jennings stays in his crease to defend it.
Angling into the stumps, Jennings stays in line of the ball to defend it.
A real quick delivery outside off, Jennings gets  the toe end of the bat and ball goes behind the stumps. That was really close to the stumps.

Tossed up and Jennings goes for a sweep again but is unable to make contact.
Pitched outside off, left alone.
On the stumps, Jennings sweeps it on the on side. Amit Mishra was quick to save the single.
Short ball outside off, Cook tries to pull it but is unable to make contact.
A bit short and angling into the body, Jennings camps back and half pulls it towards square leg for a single.
Outside off, Cook guides it through point for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Cook tries to pull it but is unable to make contact.

UMESH YADAV into the attack for the first time in this innings!
Pitched on the stumps, Jennings goes for a reverse sweep and the ball goes straight to the fielder at second slip.

Length ball outside off, left alone by Cook.
Short ball on his body, Cook moves across and tries to pull it but he misses to make contact. Parthiv has a loud shout but seemed like that he was the only one interested there.
Slower ball outside off, Cook reads that well and drives it towards mid off.
Length ball outside off, Cook moves a bit towards the off stump to defend it.

Cook flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.

Floated up on the stumps, Cook lunges into to defend that one.
Floated up, Cook gets in line of the ball to defend it.

Cook lunges forward to defend the ball which is pitched outside off.

Cook leans forward to defend the ball.

ISHANT SHARMA to bowl from the other end!
On the pads, Jennings flicks it towards mid-wicket for a couple. First runs of the day.

Just before entering the field, the Indian players are posing for the photographs. The players are out in the middle for the final day's play. The overnight batsmen COOK and JENNINGS will start the proceedings with the bat. RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN will start with the ball for India.

On the other hand, the visitors will have to bat out really well to see out the day as it's a mission of 90 overs for both the teams. England who batted for 157 overs in the first innings will hope to dish out a similar performance again as the pitch has not changed a lot. It will be an exciting day's play for sure as India will try to finish off the series with a 4-0 whitewash. Join us in a while as live action is underway.

Hello and a warm welcome on Day 5 of the final Test between India and England. India hold the upper hand in the match as there are only two results possible for them - a win or a draw. The hosts will try to rattle out the openers as soon as possible to impose some real pressure on the English middle order.
... DAY 5, SESSION 1...

The task is cut out for the Englishmen. Cook and co. very well know that it will need them to bat out of their skins if they are to draw this Test match. The only thing they would be eyeing for will be to take it session-by-session. So, with a full day's play remaining, one side needs to bat it out while other needs 10 wickets. Who will come on top? A battle to survival beckons us. Catch us at 0930 IST for the final day's play. Until then, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

The hosts wiped out the deficit and then took the lead to 282, which should tell you the story of the Indian innings all by itself. The home side declared very late in the day, but they would consider it to be worthy. England was asked to come out and deal with just 5 overs and the only smiling point for them in the hard toiling day would be to head back unscathed.

A fabulous day of Test cricket comes to an end! It has been India's day by miles. And the highlight package of the day goes without saying - Karun Nair and his triple hundred. He becomes only the third player overall and the first Indian to covert his maiden ton into a triple. Every Indian batsmen came in and got the purchase from the pitch. It was once again proved that this Indian team can bat and bat deep. Ashwin, Jadeja played the supporting role and not only helped Nair achieve the feat but also helped their side post a gigantic total on the board.
